<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the low-field region (≈10–30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows two such peaks: one at 26.29 ppm (typical methyl) and another at 43.30 ppm (a methyl attached to an electronegative atom). No other low‑field peaks are present, so the molecule contains two methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
